title: Strawberry Salad Dessert
description: This strawberry salad dessert recipe is an easy, refreshing, cool gelatin treat made with angel food cake, whipped topping, and frozen strawberries.
ingredients: 1 (18.25 ounce) package angel food cake mix
1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) with oven rack in lowest position.
Beat cake mix and 1 ¼ cups cold water in a bowl using an electric mixer on low speed until moistened, about 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed for 1 minute. Pour into an ungreased angel food tube pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden brown and cracked, looks very dry and firm to the touch, 33 to 38 minutes.

Cool cake in the pan, inverted onto a wire rack, empty wine bottle, or thin-necked glass bottle; this will prevent the cake from sinking, about 1 ½ hours. Loosen edges with a flat knife or a spatula to remove cake. Trim crust from cake; save for another use. Cut cake into cubes, or tear into bite-sized chunks; set aside.

Combine boiling water and gelatin in a large bowl; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in frozen strawberries and remaining 1 cup cold water. Chill until slightly thickened to the consistency of egg whites; it may reach this stage while stirring.
Gently fold cake cubes and whipped topping into strawberry mixture. Chill until set, about 2 hours. Decorate top with any remaining strawberries and whipped topping.
